troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.shortdesc: If you experience problems with , consult this section for common issues and their solutions.

condition.p: You cannot send or receive messages.

cause.title: You cannot login
cause.p: The application rejects your login credentials.

step.cmd: Check that your CAPS LOCK key is not active.
Verify that you are using the correct email address for your account.
Reset your password using the Forgot Password? link on the Talk Selection Screen.
If the problem persists, contact your organization administrator to confirm your account has not been suspended.
Check the user's account status in the administration portal at and reactivate it if it has been suspended.

cause.title: The application lost connectivity
cause.p: You cannot see other participants' replies, or messages fail to send.

step.cmd: Verify that your Internet connection is active by opening a web browser.
Check the application proxy settings under Settings Network.
Confirm that ports 443 (HTTPS) and 8883 (MQTT over TLS) are not blocked by your firewall or security software. See for the full list of required ports.
Click Reconnect in the status bar at the bottom of the application window.

cause.title: Notifications are not appearing
cause.p: You are not receiving desktop notifications for new messages.

step.cmd: Open Settings Notifications and confirm that Desktop notifications is enabled.
Check your operating system's notification settings to ensure is allowed to display notifications.
Verify that Do Not Disturb mode is not currently active.

cause.title: The application crashes on startup
cause.p: closes immediately after launching, or displays an error dialog on startup.

step.cmd: Ensure your operating system meets the minimum requirements listed in .

Delete the application cache folder and restart. The cache folder location depends on your operating system: on Windows it is %APPDATA%\CircleChat\cache, on Mac it is ~/Library/Caches/CircleChat, and on Linux it is ~/.cache/circlechat.
Reinstall the application using the latest installer from .
If the crash persists, collect the log file from %APPDATA%\CircleChat\logs\circlechat.log (Windows) or ~/.local/share/circlechat/logs/circlechat.log (Linux/Mac) and contact support.
